evidence: Exercises opportunistic 1p1c package relay, peer liveness, and orphan handling against adversarial peers.
rationale: Adds an end-to-end liveness fuzz target for opportunistic 1p1c relay and orphan resolution. The fuzzer asserts that an honest peer announcing an acceptable package child eventually gets it accepted despite stalling or malleating peers, and it has already uncovered an orphan-retry assertion failure.
